sobre.hero_subtitle: Conheça Farmácia is an organization dedicated to promoting excellence in pharmaceutical practice through the sharing of informative content, creation of training programs, and connection between healthcare professionals, students, institutions, and society — promoting practical and up-to-date knowledge.
sobre.missao_p1: To connect knowledge, people, and healthcare practices to strengthen professional performance, improve patient care, and drive the development of the pharmaceutical sector in Angola.
sobre.missao_p2: We empower pharmacy professionals nationwide with up-to-date knowledge and continuous training — in-person and online — that helps them perform their role efficiently and ethically. Our work integrates workshops, lectures, scientific events, and the production of educational content for social media, radio, and television, with a focus on social impact, technical quality, and interdisciplinarity.
sobre.card1_text: We regularly share content about the pharmaceutical field through social media, radio, television, and health education campaigns — with up-to-date information and practical tips to improve professional practice.
sobre.card2_text: We organize training in various areas of pharmacy, empowering professionals and students through continuous education and quality scientific events — promoting ethical, critical, and collaborative practice.
sobre.pull_quote: "Knowledge that connects. Training that transforms. Health that evolves."

interacoes_page.fontes_subtitle: Drug–drug interactions are anchored to FDA-approved labels (DailyMed/NIH) and publicly accessible NIH clinical sources (MedlinePlus, PubMed). Official European SmPCs can be consulted on the EMA and, in Portugal, on the INFARMED portal.

interacoes_faq.title: Frequently asked questions about the checker
interacoes_faq.subtitle: Answers to common questions about how interaction checking works.
interacoes_faq.quais_tipos_q: Which types of interactions are checked?
interacoes_faq.quais_tipos_a: The checker covers four types: drug–drug, drug–food or drink, drug–disease and drug–pregnancy/breastfeeding. Each type has its own tab for quick access.
interacoes_faq.o_que_e_a: An interaction happens when a medicine, food, drink, disease or condition changes how another medicine acts in the body — increasing or decreasing its effect, or creating a new risk. Not every combination is dangerous, but some require monitoring or dose adjustment.
interacoes_faq.severidade_a: We classify interactions as Critical, Moderate and Minor based on reference literature. Severity reflects the likelihood and potential seriousness of the event, not an individual certainty.
interacoes_faq.nao_avaliada_a: It means there is no documented information for that selection in our database yet. The absence of a record does not mean no interaction exists — always confirm with a healthcare professional and reference literature.
interacoes_faq.substitui_medico_q: Does the tool replace medical evaluation?
interacoes_faq.substitui_medico_a: No. This is an educational support tool. The therapeutic decision always belongs to a qualified healthcare professional who considers the patient as a whole.
interacoes_faq.fontes_a: Drug–drug interactions are anchored to FDA-approved labels (DailyMed/NIH) and NIH clinical sources (PubMed). The food, disease and pregnancy dimensions follow EMC-UK (MHRA) as the canonical source, corroborated by Health Canada. Official European SmPCs can be consulted on the EMA and, in Portugal, on the INFARMED portal (Infomed).
interacoes_faq.mais_de_dois_q: Can I check more than two drugs at once?
interacoes_faq.mais_de_dois_a: Yes. Add as many drugs as you want; the pairs among all selected drugs are calculated.
